ev_0004.summary: Figure: circle_01 centre O(233.27,201.1), radius 157.33 px. Horizontal diameter MN lies on solid segment seg_01 from M(75.94,201) to N(390.6,201); both M and N are on the circle (M = O - r, N = O + r). O is the midpoint of MN. P(269.46,201.12) lies on MN between O and N, strictly inside the circle (about 36 px from O), so P is not on the circle. Two solid chords radiate from P: PA, going up-right to a top point at (311.37,64.53), and PB, going to B(369.44,122.29). Both endpoints lie on the circle (distance from O is about 157.3 px for each). The top point is unlabelled in the CV output, but the figure image shows a letter 'A' just above-right of it, so it is labelled A (visual reading, not a CV binding). B is confirmed on the circle; the B label is at (391,103). Segment endpoints at (313.23,58.49) and (270,199)/(271,200) are within about 6 px of A and P, so they were snapped to those vertices as detector noise.

Coordinates are relative to O at (0,0), y flipped. No right_angle objects in the GES, so no marks. Labels are placed away from the figure: M left, N right, O and P below, A above, B above right.
